libheif-js 1.19.8 (Emscripten build)
====================================

This directory contains the unmodified `libheif-wasm` bundle from the
`libheif-js` npm package:

  https://www.npmjs.com/package/libheif-js
  https://github.com/catdad-experiments/libheif-js

The bundle embeds an Emscripten build of:

  libheif 1.23.5
    https://github.com/strukturag/libheif
    License: GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0 (library)

  libde265 (HEVC decoder)
    https://github.com/strukturag/libde265
    License: GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0

The full LGPL-3.0 text is in LICENSE.txt. The WASM is served unmodified as a
separate file from the site and is used only in the visitor's browser for
local HIF/HEIF decoding. No HIF files are sent to the server by this code.

To replace the bundled decoder with a build of your own, rebuild libheif-js
from the sources above and replace libheif-bundle.js; keep this notice and
the license text with the new file.
